note: Award-winning pharma marketing campaigns relevant to the flagship roster (clients Bayer/Ipsen/Genmab/Novartis/Pfizer/Incyte, their brands and therapy areas), captured from festival results and trade press (Cannes Lions Health/Pharma, Clio Health, PM360 Pharma Choice/Trailblazer, MM+M, Fierce Pharma Marketing). awards.title: Relax Your Tight End ("Relax, It's a Blood Test")
awards.roster_link_note: Prostate cancer is the roster therapy area for Pluvicto and (with Bayer) Nubeqa, giving direct disease-state adjacency for their HCP/patient engagement.
awards.why_awarded: Took a stigmatized private-health topic (prostate cancer screening) and turned it into mainstream Super Bowl entertainment, destigmatizing testing at massive reach. The jury rewarded the cultural bravery and craft of converting a screening-avoidance taboo into a broadly shareable, memorable idea.
awards.key_message: Prostate cancer screening starts with a simple blood test, not the invasive procedure men fear. 'Relax your tight end' plays on the NFL position and the literal nudge to stop clenching; 1 in 8 men will be diagnosed in their lifetime, so relax and get the blood test.
awards.creative_summary: 60-second Super Bowl LX (Feb 8, 2026) spot: current and former NFL tight ends (George Kittle, Colby Parkinson, Rob Gronkowski, Greg Olsen, Tony Gonzalez, Delanie Walker, Vernon Davis) plus survivor/coach Bruce Arians shown 'relaxing' (floating in a pool, doing yoga, hair being brushed, painting a portrait of Arians), set to Enya's 'Only Time'. Unbranded disease-awareness, humor-led destigmatization.
awards.images_description: Hero imagery: NFL tight ends in full uniform in absurdly relaxed poses (pool float, yoga mat, spa); portrait-painting vignette of Bruce Arians; on-screen line 'Relax, it's a blood test'.

awards.title: Cosentyx Dermatology Marketing Strategy
awards.roster_link_note: Cosentyx is a roster brand (Novartis IL-17A franchise).
awards.agency: Neon (IPG Health) and Rise & Run (IPG Health)
awards.why_awarded: Recognized for a data-driven dermatology marketing strategy defending and extending an established IL-17A brand across multiple indications: a model for mature-brand omnichannel lifecycle management.
awards.key_message: Sustained IL-17A leadership and speed-of-response messaging across plaque psoriasis, psoriatic arthritis, axial spondyloarthritis and hidradenitis suppurativa.
awards.creative_summary: Integrated HCP + patient omnichannel dermatology program spanning multiple indications; agency-led strategy and creative for a mature multi-indication franchise.
awards.images_description: Branded Cosentyx dermatology creative across HCP and DTC channels (specific hero assets held on agency/award pages).

awards.title: Mirena "Seeing Red"
awards.roster_link_note: Bayer is a roster client; Mirena sits in Bayer's women's-health portfolio (adjacent to the roster's Lynkuet menopause franchise as a women's-health engagement exemplar).
awards.why_awarded: Recognized for a bold, category-challenging direct-to-consumer creative that broke women's-health advertising conventions to drive candid conversation.
awards.key_message: Destigmatize and normalize an open conversation about menstruation and contraceptive choice: a confident, unapologetic DTC voice.
awards.creative_summary: DTC campaign using a striking 'red' visual language to confront period taboos and prompt provider conversations about the Mirena IUD.
awards.images_description: Bold red-forward art direction across DTC video and OOH (hero assets on the award/agency pages).

awards.title: Cannes Lions 2025 Pharma Lions: roster-client medaling cohort
awards.roster_link_note: At Cannes Lions 2025, roster clients Bayer and Novartis medaled (Bayer silver; Novartis US bronze + Argentina bronze), alongside Takeda, Lilly and Biogen silvers, useful proof these clients compete for and win creative honors.
awards.why_awarded: Industry context: the 2025 Pharma Lions saw record drugmaker participation; Bayer took a silver and Novartis took two bronzes, evidence roster clients are active, awarded creators (even in a year the top Grand Prix went to Viatris' 'Make Love Last').
awards.key_message: (Cohort/context entry: multiple campaigns; see sources for individual pieces.)
awards.creative_summary: Multiple award-winning executions from roster clients and peers; recorded here as competitive/creative-benchmark context for the roster.
awards.images_description: Varies by campaign (see Cannes Lions winners gallery).

awards.title: Clio Health 2025: therapy-area creative benchmarks

awards.why_awarded: Benchmark context: Area 23 swept Agency of the Year with data-driven and craft-led health work ('In Transit', 'Magnetic Stories'); useful as a creative-quality reference when briefing roster campaigns.
